rows.en: Whoooa!! I'm gettin' all fired up!!!
I'll prove that the strongest in the universe is me.
You lot should go and take a look at it for yourselves, too.
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
Tch, we don't have time to spare. Hurry it up.
Sorry, but my next fight is about to start. I'll see you in the finals.
The bubbles it blows can burn up anything... A fearsome opponent.
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
Curse you... To think that I would lose...!!
Who's there!? Who was that just now...?
Watch yourselves! See ya!!
...That kind of desire is dangerous.
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
Jack, Ace, Accel and Birth headed back to base.
Corpses lie strewn all over the plaza!
This might have something to do with that "gang of robbers" Birth was talking about...
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
I know. We're going to Ultra Tower!
...Guess we've got no choice but to go on.
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
...It won't open. Let's try looking somewhere else.
Let's try heading east. We might be able to get through that way.
Another Gundam, huh...
The road to the Tower is just ahead! We're out of time! Let's hurry!!
Uva...? Did he just say Uva?
Well, my match is about to start, so I'm off.
The Violence Dopant VS Alien Reflect match is underway... Go in if you want to watch.
The Masurao VS Zamsha match is underway. Go in if you want to watch.
The Walter Gundam VS Pandon match is underway. Go in if you want to watch.
As soon as the other matches are over, assemble at your respective venues.
You can also watch the other matches. Why not go and have a look?
Looks like the semifinals are about to start. Let's go.
Looks like the semifinals are about to start. Let's go.
Looks like the semifinals are about to start. Let's go.

Hey, before that, let's go get a look at who we're up against.
You can also watch the other matches. Why not go and have a look?
In a single blow...? Tch, looks like he really is a formidable foe...
Zamsha, the Space Swordsman... He's quite something... More than fit to serve as material.
Now then, heroes... I'll have you run wild for me a little longer...
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
And they've even got kaiju and kaijin in here...
Lunaticks suddenly attacked!
Gomora suddenly attacked!
Zanjioh suddenly attacked!
Gebacondor suddenly attacked!
Eleking suddenly attacked!
Gaina Ninpo suddenly attacked!
Snowgon suddenly attacked!
Curse you, heroes!! But it won't go like this next time, understand? Mark my words!
Dada panicked and fled.
Hey! You big glutton! Come and get me! Think you can eat me!?
The black shadow in the cage was eerily silent.
You're rather good, it seems. Oh, well. You'll pay for this!

Ahead: 2F Special Exhibit Room
"Treasure Collection"
Use the "Key Ring"?
Guess we start by checkin' out this room, huh? I ain't any good with this kinda stuff, though.

Hey. We're searching the other display stands. There should be Core Medals here somewhere.
Tch! Why the hell isn't the real thing here!? The bird Cores are mine!
Huh!? Idiots! Why the hell aren't they here!!
Tch... Don't tell me they've been stolen?
Hmph, it's pointless without the real thing.
Now then, I shall shut myself away in my laboratory. I wish to concentrate for a while.
Looks like they've got no will to fight. We'll skip the pointless battle.
Someone here must be doing research on Medals.

notes.note: No name box in script (plays after flag 907 / Mebius check); the same line is Ankh's in 0422/0425/0429, so voiced as Ankh and reused that English.
Script: God Gundam (Ankh-variant block 23-31 duplicates 13-19). Identical to #0.19, same English.
Rider 1 about the Aquatic Kaijin Team member who blows burning bubbles; not named, so 'it'.
Script: Ankh (CharaNameIn 36 before +123), reacting to God Gundam joining.

No speaker recovered. Bogal leader-variant block (+13+k, 15 leaders) cannot fit before narration #26; rows 29-31 look like overflow variants. Rough voice (Momotaros or Zero likely); exact leader uncertain.
Leader variant k=14 of +5+k; the 0521 Pt_Chara_Check chain puts Den-O (Momotaros) last. Voiced as Momotaros.
Source has a dragon kanji where 'shut oneself in' (komoru) fits; treated as a mis-decoded glyph.
Subject unstated (whoever uses this lab, presumably Ikadevil); kept impersonal 'someone here'.
'he' = Ikadevil, named two rows earlier as taking these Core Medals (glossary g=m).

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers settled from scripts and table context; uncertain: 0514#31 (leader variant, rough voice), 0521#20 (Momotaros via check order), 0418#74 (no name box, Ankh by identical lines). 0560#92 mis-decoded kanji. No new names.
